about: Nan province, northern Thailand. Pass of 2026-11-02: nothing cleared the verify bar; every candidate is register-only or a group without a single viewing spot.

leads.name: Giant Chilli Tree (Ton Kom), Wat Phra That Chom Phrik
leads.note: Register-only (about 800 years, girth 8 m, h 10 m, temple in care per history_th). No dated alive evidence, no second source found (Thai and English searches return nothing), botanical identity of Kom not found. Register pin is approximate. Needs a temple page, visitor post or photo with a date.

leads.name: Chomphu Phu Kha trees, Doi Phu Kha National Park
leads.note: Alive: bloom reported 2023-02-23 (asianews.network) and early March 2021 (gt-rider.com thread). Wild rare trees, register girth only 0.30 m; viewpoints on Highway 1256 about 4 km from the park HQ, no single tree or trail coordinate. Park fee 200 THB foreign adult per thaiholidayguide (not official). Group, not a collectible point, not ancient: lead until a named trail tree has a coordinate.

leads.name: Giant Tao Rang (fishtail palm), Doi Phu Kha National Park
leads.note: 2019 list names only. No trail, coordinate or species found in two searches. No alive evidence.

leads.name: Crape myrtle group, Ban Mai Nai Fan road
leads.note: Register-only, group along a road into a Mien village, biggest about 300 years, girth stated as 5 arm-spans (no metres), h 20 m, care of the tambon administration. No second source or alive evidence found. Group on a road, species only mapped from the Thai name Tabaek.
